verdict.rationale: Evidence shows llama.cpp running standard LLMs (Qwen) and multi-modal/vision models (VLM session, Gemma-3 vision) both in first-party CLI examples and corroborated by hands-on community reports of vision working well, plus broad quantization/backend support implying wide model compatibility. However, there is no explicit evidence of MoE model support or embedding-model support, nor any claim/count of 'hundreds' of architectures. missing for 10: explicit MoE architecture support, explicit embedding model support, and a documented breadth/count of supported architectures.
